description: Backtrace (backtraceio) Android crash/error & ANR reporting SDK. Has no auto-init ContentProvider — the app constructs BacktraceClient manually and opts in via BacktraceExceptionHandler.enable(client) (global uncaught handler), enableAnr / native integration, and metrics. Exodus classifies it as a tracker. Seen in ~4 kids apps (Budge/Barbie).

methods.name: enable
methods.note: static void enable(BacktraceClient) — installs the global Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler. Stubbing prevents automatic capture/exfiltration of uncaught crashes. KEY entry point (there is no auto-init provider).

methods.name: setCustomAttributes
methods.note: static void — attaches attributes to auto-reported crashes.

methods.name: send
methods.note: void — manual report submission (Throwable/Exception/String/BacktraceReport overloads). Core exfiltration path.

methods.name: enableAnr
methods.note: void — installs the ANR watchdog that reports application-not-responding events.

methods.name: enableNativeIntegration
methods.note: void overloads — installs the native (NDK) crash handler.

methods.name: tryEnableNativeIntegration
methods.note: Returns boolean; stub false (native handler not installed).

methods.name: enableBreadcrumbs
methods.note: Returns boolean; stub false (breadcrumb collection not enabled).

methods.name: setOnRequestHandler
methods.note: void — sets the HTTP request handler used for delivery.

methods.name: send
methods.note: void — flushes queued metric events to Backtrace.
